definitionZh: 设置的 CSS 短手属性对应上,右,下,和/或左属性. 其比值简写法的多值语法相同.
sourceDefinition: The inset CSS shorthand property corresponds to the top, right, bottom, and/or left properties. It has the same multi-value syntax of the margin shorthand.
